svg.aria-label: How Qwen2-VL sizes an image. The image keeps its proportions: its sides are rounded to multiples of 28 pixels and the area is kept under a budget. The encoder cuts it into 14-pixel patches, and a merger joins every 2 by 2 block of patches into one token, so each token covers 28 by 28 pixels. A 864 by 1296 receipt becomes 364 by 532 pixels, 247 tokens or 728 by 1092 pixels, 1014 tokens under budgets of 256 and 1024 tokens

svg.text: Qwen2-VL: the image keeps its shape, and one token covers 28×28 pixels
14-px patches, merged 2×2; the budget sets how many tokens the image may cost
a 864×1296 receipt, the same picture: the budget trades reading detail for tokens
